Audited all 15 Roman verses against the Urdu in [shaah-salamunalaik.md](src/data/lyrics/shaah-salamunalaik.md). Corrected “Hyder o safdar” to “Akbar o Safdar” to match اکبر و صفدر, removed a duplicate izafat in the Qaasim line, and normalized Roman spelling, capitalization, and title spacing.

Preserved the Urdu text and stanza alignment. Where Urdu leaves the izafat unmarked, I retained the reading indicated by the existing Roman.
